tools.name: search_lenders
tools.description: Search the UK specialty business finance lenders that FundBiz reviews (editorial research, not a lender panel). Filter by free-text query, product type, or eligibility flags. Returns factual terms (ticket range, typical rate, decision time, soft-search, Ltd-only) plus an editorial rating. Read-only.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_lenders" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
